law: every cloned file re-hashes to TC11's STAGE_D_MANIFEST.json (files[] + out_of_scope_snapshot_files[]) BEFORE any extension; a file the manifest does not pin is compared with its own bytes in the TC11 snapshot; the clone's file set equals the source tree's; any mismatch HALTs before anything is filed
method: cp -cpR (APFS clonefile, permissions and times preserved)
